headline: Argentina Enters Technical Recession After September Decline
summary: Argentina's economic activity declined in September, marking the third consecutive annual drop. The country is now in a technical recession, with third-quarter activity falling 1.2% compared to the same period last year.
why: Argentina is a major South American economy; its recession highlights the challenges of high inflation, fiscal deficits, and policy uncertainty.
